Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

impatient adjective

also impatiently, be impatient with

classical

Cic. Tusc. 2.5 (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 154
Traupman 331

inīquō animō ferre

with the accusative of what one bears

to bear impatiently, be impatient with

The opposite of aequō animō ferre, bear patiently. inīquō animō on its own is “impatiently”.

Other words

  • impatiēns, impatientis — impatient (of), unable to bear

    declension · also used · classical

See also patient, calmly.

SourcesLewis & Short: iniquus

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 331.
